home.headline: Better connections
home.lede: Take a one-minute mission and discover how a simple first move can turn a room full of strangers into a squad.

mission.label: First contact
mission.title: A new player walks up alone.
mission.prompt: They’re interested—but they don’t know anyone yet. What’s your first move?
mission.retryHint: Strong communities start by making room. Try the choice that puts connection first.

choices.label: Let them watch first
choices.detail: Give them time to learn the group from the sidelines.

choices.label: Make the first introduction
choices.detail: Invite them in, learn their name, and find a game you share.

choices.label: Start with the rules
choices.detail: Explain how the community works before getting acquainted.

completion.title: That’s how community starts.
completion.lede: You didn’t start with a pitch or a rulebook. You started with a person.
completion.aboutTitle: Gaming with purpose. Community for life.
completion.aboutBody: Combat Tested Gaming brings veterans and allies together through gaming, shared experiences, and genuine connection.
completion.qrAlt: QR code to connect with Combat Tested Gaming
